description: The legs with their tops of descent at three to one (333 ft a nm, about a 3 degree path, AIM 2-1-2's VASI glide path) to the pattern altitude where the 45-degree entry begins, about 1.7 nm before the end (AC 90-66C 11.2, 11.3: level at pattern altitude before entering), to an approach's fix end_before_nm short of it, and to a lower leg's altitude by the fix it starts at -- or, for a leg marked start_at (a pilot's Start At), from that fix on, the top of descent at the end of the leg before; the times and fuel unchanged. A top of descent's minutes and gallons are those flown to it: what a leg flies beyond its line, counted at its end (its procedure's more_min and more_gal, a hold with at_end), comes after it.

end_before_nm.description: How far before the legs' end the descent is finished, nm: an approach's fix's distance out; where not given, down to a pattern, where the 45-degree entry begins (limits::pattern_entry_start_nm, about 1.7 nm), and 0 with an end_fix.
